在楚紫岚彻底退烧后，容辞才回了家。
明天晚上出席宴会的礼服她还没准备。
到了高奢礼服店，店里店长和几个店员都围着一套礼服上下打点。
直到容辞走近了，她们才注意到她。
她虽嫁入了封家，可这些年，她却基本上没有怎么参加过什么宴会。
毕竟，封庭深和桑倩他们就算有正式场合要出席，也不会带上她。
至于封老太太，她退居幕后多年，早就不关心那些名利场了。
容辞对礼服研究虽然不多，但楚紫岚是做高端服饰的，耳濡目染下，基本的审美她还是有的。
只是，店里漂亮的礼服实在是太多了，看得人眼花缭乱。
容辞也没打算精挑细选，觉得过得去就行。
她正这么想着，那几位店员刚才围着整理的那套礼服完整地映入她的眼眸。
那是一套淡紫色半透薄纱束腰礼服，礼服腰间掐花别致精美，搭配模特脖颈上高雅名贵的项链，把飘逸与华贵完美地融合在了一起。
她刚要伸手，想试一下衣服质感，手还没碰到礼服，就被店长用力地抓住了手。
店长忙松开了手：“抱歉小姐，我不是故意的，只是，这套礼服是我们高级客户的私人订制，全球仅此一件，价格不菲，要出了什么差错，我们这边是承担不起……”
店里礼服少的几万一套，中等的十几到几十万，贵的要过百万，可就算是店里最昂贵的那一批礼服，在刚才那套礼服的衬托下，都显得那么的平庸又平淡。
最后，容辞挑了一身挑花米白丝质长裙。
在容辞结账，让人把礼服包好时，她听到不远处两位店员小声地说道，“这项链＋礼服，据说总金额超三千万呢，这是把一套大别墅穿身上了啊，有钱人真是奢侈。”

“可不是么，而且，这衣服人家很可能就只穿一次……”
原来这么贵，就算没主，她也花不起这个钱。
回到家，楚紫岚打了个电话过来说明天晚上要请她吃大餐。
得知她明天要参加晚宴，第二天下午，就风风火火地过来，要亲自给容辞做造型。
容辞眼光不差，礼服挑得不错，再搭配上楚紫岚精心为她打造的妆容，把容辞温婉大方，漂亮干净的气质极好的凸显了出来。
晚上郁默勋来接人，见到容辞时，直接被容辞惊艳到了：“很美，很适合你。”
上了车，郁默勋说道，“那，明天正式回归公司？”
“正好林芜，”想到她不知道林芜是谁，他又解释道，“就是上次我跟你说的那个算法天才，她也明天正式入职，到时候我正好介绍你们认识——”
容辞脸色一顿：“林芜？你说那个人叫林芜？是荒芜的芜吗？是前段时间从a国回来的？”

Chapter 21 She is worthless in front of you (Page 1)
After Chu Zilan's fever completely subsided, Rong Ci returned home.
She hasn't prepared the dress for the party tomorrow night.
When we arrived at the luxury dress store, the store manager and several clerks were all arranging a dress.
It wasn't until Rong Ci got closer that they noticed her.
Although she married into the Feng family, she had rarely attended any banquets in these years.
After all, even if Feng Tingshen and Sang Qian had to attend a formal occasion, they would not bring her with them.
As for Mrs. Feng, she has retreated behind the scenes for many years and has long since ceased to care about the vanity fair.
Although Rong Ci didn't study much about dresses, Chu Zilan made high-end clothes, so she still had the basic aesthetics.
However, there were so many beautiful dresses in the store that it was dazzling.
Rong Ci didn't intend to be careful in his selection, as long as he thought it was passable.
Just as she was thinking this, the dress that the clerks were sorting around just now came into her eyes completely.
It was a lavender semi-sheer tulle waist dress with unique and exquisite flowers at the waist. It was paired with an elegant and precious necklace around the model's neck, perfectly blending elegance and luxury.
She was about to reach out to try the texture of the clothes, but before her hand touched the dress, the store manager grabbed her hand forcefully.
The store manager quickly let go of his hand: "I'm sorry, Miss, I didn't mean to do it. It's just that this dress is privately customized for our high-end customers. It's the only one in the world. It's expensive. If something goes wrong, we can't afford it..."
The number of dresses in the store ranges from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands, and the more expensive ones cost over a million. But even the most expensive dresses in the store all look so mediocre and plain against the backdrop of the dress just now.
Finally, Rong Ci chose a floral off-white silk dress.
When Rong Ci was checking out and having the dress wrapped, she heard two clerks not far away whispering, "It is said that the total price of this necklace + dress exceeds 30 million. This is like wearing a large villa. Rich people are really luxurious."
"Isn't it? Moreover, I will probably only wear this clothes once..."
It turned out that it was so expensive, even if she didn't have the owner, she couldn't afford it.
When she got home, Chu Zilan called and told her that she would be treating her to a big dinner tomorrow night.
After learning that she was attending a dinner party tomorrow, she rushed over the next afternoon to personally style Rong Ci.
Rong Ci has good taste and picked a good dress. Coupled with the makeup that Chu Zilan carefully created for her, Rong Ci's gentle and generous, beautiful and clean temperament is perfectly highlighted.
Yu Moxun came to pick her up in the evening. When he saw Rong Ci, he was immediately stunned by Rong Ci: "It's beautiful and suits you very well."
After getting in the car, Yu Moxun said, "So, will you officially return to the company tomorrow?"
"It just so happens that Lin Wu," thinking that she didn't know who Lin Wu was, he explained, "is the algorithm genius I told you about last time. She will officially join the job tomorrow. I will introduce you to you then-"
Rong Ci's expression paused: "Lin Wu? You said that person's name is Lin Wu? Is it Huang Wu's Wu? Did he come back from country A some time ago?"
